title: Line sketch: Cracked Eye with Repair
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A hyperrealistic human eye rendered in grayscale with a vibrant and iris, set against a background. The entire composition is fractured like broken ceramic, with the cracks highlighted in shimmering leaf, creating a kintsugi effect (derived from painting #633).
